props.name: variant
props.description: The visual variant of the button. `outline` fill-style is only supported with `primary` and `secondary`. `static-color` is only supported with `primary` and `secondary`.

props.name: fillStyle
props.description: The fill style of the button. `outline` is only supported with `primary` and `secondary` variants.

props.name: staticColor
props.description: Static color treatment for display over colored or image backgrounds. Only supported with `primary` and `secondary` variants.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Whether overflowing text is truncated with an ellipsis rather than wrapping. Replaces the legacy `no-wrap` attribute from 1st-gen.

props.name: justified
props.description: Enables the button to become full-width, if the container allows it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the button is disabled. Removes focusability and prevents interaction.

props.name: accessibleLabel
props.description: Accessible label forwarded to the internal `<button>` element as `aria-label`. Required for icon-only buttons, which have no visible text.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon displayed before the label.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Leading icon displayed before the label.
